lines.text: The apostles performed many signs and wonders, and all the sick who were brought to them were healed.
The high priest and the Sadducees arrested the apostles, but during the night an angel opened the jail doors.
After someone reported the apostles teaching in the temple courts, the high priest brought them gently, fearing the people.
A Pharisee named Gamaliel reminded the Council of Theudas and Judas Iscariot, and urged leaving the apostles alone.
The Council had the apostles flogged and released them, and they left rejoicing and kept teaching daily.
